chapter: Publishing, Jelly Roll in Los Angeles and band lore
title: The Long Beach Pike roller coaster band and the Pacific Electric dance hall
summary: Spikes's small band drew crowds from a bandstand over the roller coaster, which led to a big band job at the Pacific Electric dance hall in Long Beach.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, they might have...might have when...you see, I think he went to work, too, for...uh...no, he kind of formed his own band after he left me, and see, I had the big job at the dancehall in uh... in...uh, Long Beach. Had the great big dancehall there, and I put this big band in there, and how I got that job, I used to play for the Rolly Coas' [roller coaster]. You...we had a bandstand up this way, and on Saturdays and Sundays, I had that job at the...for the Rolly Coas'. We'd play fifteen or twenty minutes. Then we'd get off and walk around twenty or thirty minutes so the people could ride...'cause we'd draw a big crowd, then we'd... Soon as the crowd got big, we'd quit. So then, the...down at the...they had a big dancehall down there owned by the Pacific Electric Railroad Company. They hired us to go in there and play, so we played in there a couple of seasons, and that's when I sent and got uh...
Lionel. And us...because up on this bandstand,

we only had...I had banjo and sax and drum and piano, and that's about all 'cause it little bandstand about as big as over there, you know--up over the ticket office. And the crowds would jam around, and then we'd quit, and they'd...everybody'd ride awhile. Then we'd... When the crowds was all gone, we come back and played another fifteen or twenty minutes.
That was at the...the...the roller coaster at the Long Beach Pike?
And, you remember the name of...of...of the dancehall there?
Well, I guess it's Pacific Electric Dancehall. I don't know. It was owned by them, and I guess it's the Long Beach Pavilion DanceHall, I think they called it or something.
